Curious by nature.
Builder by choice.

I'm Manav Tailor, a frontend developer and full stack developer based in Udaipur, India. I like figuring out how things fit together — and making them feel effortless to use.

This portfolio brings together my frontend and full stack development work: React, Next.js and TypeScript interfaces connected to Node.js, GraphQL APIs and PostgreSQL databases. I turn complex requirements into useful software.
